subject: Timeline concern: MAP & evaluation window
content_summary: Customer requests a 2-week pad on the MAP evaluation window due to internal testing delays. Sales proposes rebaselined milestones, a one-time credit, and next steps for procurement and DocuSign.
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@clearhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Julie Parks <julie.parks@clearhealth.com>, procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Timeline concern: MAP & evaluation window

Rachel,

Quick note from our side — we're running into an internal testing bottleneck that will push our acceptance run by roughly 10-14 days. The evaluation team discovered a data-parity issue that requires an additional sprint to validate ingestion and edge-case handling.

Given that, we need to understand two things from Redwood:
- Can the MAP be rebaselined to add a 2-week acceptance pad?
- Is there any play on credits or a pro-rated start on billing until our acceptance completes?

Julie (procurement) is looped in for PO/contract timing. We'd like to avoid a hard go/no-go escalation if possible, but we also need a formal plan we can share with engineering and legal.

Thanks,
Sandeep Rao
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearHealth

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline concern: MAP & evaluation window

Sandeep —

Appreciate the heads-up and the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a short acceptance pad and formalize it in the MAP. I've attached an updated MAP (MAP-v2.pdf) and an updated quote (Redwood-Quote-CLH-v3.pdf) that reflect a two-week acceptance window and a one-time credit to cover the evaluation period you're losing.

High-level rebaseline (proposal):
- Existing eval window end: 2027-07-02
- Proposed padded end: 2027-07-16 (two-week pad)
- New committed go-live target: 2027-07-23

Immediate next steps (can we confirm by EOD Thursday):
1) Julie/procurement confirms PO timing and whether Redwood can accept the PO with the updated MAP terms.
2) Camila will draft a short amendment to the MAP for signature (DocuSign link included below).
3) Grace will validate CS coverage for the extended validation period and confirm a small expansion to our on-call window during the pad.

Quick notes:
- The one-time credit is documented in the attached quote as a line item; it's conditional on the PO being issued before 2027-06-25.
- We've included a brief SOC2 summary as well; Grace, please add the SOC2 evidence packet we keep handy if they want deeper artifacts.

DocuSign (draft MAP + amendment): https://www.docusign.net/sign/embedded?txn=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CLH-2027-045

I'll leave this with Camila and Grace to pull procurement and CS details together — Sandeep, if the dates above look reasonable to you we'll queue the amendment today.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-v2.pdf, Redwood-Quote-CLH-v3.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Julie Parks <julie.parks@clearhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline concern: MAP & evaluation window

Thanks, team.

Rachel: I'll draft the amendment and send a short redline on the MAP. Julie/procurement: for PO timing, two asks that help us close the loop quickly:
- Can you confirm the approver list and the earliest PO issue date?
- Would a PO with a 30-day invoice term be acceptable, or do you need net-45/60? We can be flexible to match ClearHealth's cadence.

Grace: can you confirm CS on-call coverage for the padded window (2027-07-02 to 2027-07-16)? If there's any delta to staffing we'll mark it in the amendment.

Relevant artifacts attached: SOC2-summary.pdf (high-level), MAP-v2.pdf (redline incoming), Redwood-Quote-CLH-v3.pdf.

Proposed procurement checklist for smooth sign:
- Receipt of PO that references deal CLH-2027-045 and the MAP amendment ID (we'll assign)
- Signoff on amended acceptance window in DocuSign
- Confirmation of billing start date (we propose billing starts on go-live 2027-07-23; if you prefer billing to start at PO we can mark that explicitly)

Sandeep — if you confirm approver list and PO timing we'll prepare the DocuSign package and a one-page amendment that they can route internally.

Camila Reyes
Account Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@clearhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Julie Parks <julie.parks@clearhealth.com>, procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: 2027-06-18T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline concern: MAP & evaluation window

Thanks, Rachel and team — this all looks good. Confirming:
- Approver list: myself (Sandeep Rao), Julie Parks (Head of Procurement), and CFO (mark.davies@clearhealth.com)
- Earliest PO issue date: we can get the PO in by 2027-06-24 if the amendment and quote are final today.
- Invoice terms: we'll request net-30.

Two small asks before we sign: the MAP amendment should explicitly show the padded acceptance dates and the one-time credit line item. Also, please include the SOC2-summary.pdf in the DocuSign package so our legal team can reference it during their checklist.

Forwarding Rachel's message below for context.
